dimensions.label: Premise quality
dimensions.criterion: 3 = distinct, specific description + non-templated briefing + >=3 objectives & >=2 initial facts; 2 = most of those; 1 = generic/templated; 0 = missing core text.

dimensions.label: Narrative coherence
dimensions.criterion: Proxy only: 3 = authored narrative timeline, hidden events, and a distinct briefing; lower when templated. A human must read the prose to confirm.

dimensions.label: Canonical truth integrity
dimensions.criterion: 3 = culprit is an authored suspect, all solution fields present, timelines/clues valid; 1 point deducted per missing structural pillar.

dimensions.label: Suspect motivations
dimensions.criterion: 3 = distinct motive per suspect (+alibi); 2 = mostly distinct; 1 = reused/generic motives; 0 = missing.

dimensions.label: Evidence quality
dimensions.criterion: 3 = >=8 evidence, >=4 categories, timeline refs + several trigger types; scaled down for thinner sets.

dimensions.label: Deduction difficulty / fair challenge
dimensions.criterion: 3 = gated evidence, multiple trigger types, and NO culprit name leaked into player-facing text; leak costs 1 point.

dimensions.label: Alternative hypotheses / red herrings
dimensions.criterion: 3 = >=2 red herrings and >=2 alternative theories with hidden events; 1 = only a token of each.

dimensions.label: Evidence-to-conclusion traceability
dimensions.criterion: 3 = clue resolutions cover evidence, timeline events cite evidence, evidence carries hypothesis links.

dimensions.label: Specialist relevance
dimensions.criterion: 3 = >=3 assigned specialists with case-specific relevance and a knowledge pack; scaled down when absent.

dimensions.label: Knowledge opportunities
dimensions.criterion: 3 = knowledge pack + >=3 artifacts + learning objectives + >=1 disagreement; scaled down when absent.

dimensions.label: Perspective relevance
dimensions.criterion: Proxy only: reasoning-rich content (competing theories, red herrings) invites perspective lenses; confirm applicability by human.

dimensions.label: Discovery clue relevance
dimensions.criterion: 3 = an authored discovery-clue package with >=3 clues; 1 = none / empty.

dimensions.label: Ending quality
dimensions.criterion: 3 = substantial solution explanation + authored actual timeline + no spoiler leak into objectives/briefing.

dimensions.label: Replayability
dimensions.criterion: 3 = multiple alternative theories, multiple red herrings, multiple gated evidence paths.
